authorization: User R2 explicit one-file temporary lease
original_content:
name: DEEP500 existing-WIF read-only recovery
on:
  push:
    branches: [research/gemini-model-native500-20261107]
    paths: [.github/workflows/gemini-native500-gcs-readiness.yml]
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
jobs:
  recover:
    if: ${{ false }} # Recovery complete; keep disabled
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          project_id: gen-lang-client-0422436907
          workload_identity_provider: projects/460077888071/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/lao-github-deploy/providers/gemini-research
          service_account: gemini-research-runner@gen-lang-client-0422436907.iam.gserviceaccount.com
      - run: python3 -m pip install --quiet 'google-cloud-storage>=3,<4'
      - name: Read existing objects only
        run: python3 experiments/gemini-deep500/recover_readonly.py
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deep500-recovery-encrypted
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/deep500-recovery.p7m
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: error
